$comment: Small routing registry for project Agent Skills. This file owns role/load metadata only; each SKILL.md owns its instructions and repository authorities remain above every skill.

predictor-context.purpose: Broad investigation, audit and compact handoff context.

predictor-graph-navigation.purpose: Repository dependency, call-flow and ownership navigation.

predictor-spec-driven-delivery.purpose: Non-trivial multi-file delivery from outcome through executable evidence.

predictor-product-brainstorming.purpose: Bounded option exploration for genuinely unresolved product or architecture choices before implementation.

predictor-compound-learning.purpose: Capture only durable, evidence-backed lessons from completed work into an existing authoritative home.

predictor-ui-review.purpose: Predictor-specific UI, responsive, interaction and accessibility review.

predictor-ai-lab-verifier.purpose: AI Lab evidence and model-policy verification.

vnext-programme-runner.purpose: Resume and execute the controlled multi-stage vNext programme.

predictor-frontend-design.purpose: Impeccable-backed visual and interaction craft for new or materially reshaped Predictor UI.

predictor-motion-craft.purpose: Narrow motion craft for animation, transitions, easing, gestures and reduced-motion behaviour.

predictor-code-simplification.purpose: Behaviour-preserving simplification of recently changed code after correctness is established.

predictor-systematic-debugging.purpose: Root-cause-first defect diagnosis and regression repair.

predictor-react-best-practices.purpose: React/Vite performance, rerender, async and bundle optimization guidance.

predictor-composition-patterns.purpose: Scalable React component APIs and composition for real architecture pressure.

predictor-postgres-best-practices.purpose: Postgres/Supabase query, schema, RLS, locking and migration implementation guidance.

predictor-skill-evaluator.purpose: Measure whether a routed skill improves real repository outcomes and triggering without auto-promoting unproven skills.

predictor-differential-review.purpose: Extra blast-radius and adversarial diff review for sensitive changes only.

predictor-second-opinion.purpose: Read-only independent-model review for high-stakes architecture or release decisions.
